subject: algebra
title: Preserve equivalence in algebraic transformations
statement: Check excluded roots and both implications after non-reversible transformations such as squaring.
exclusions: operations already known to be bijective on the declared domain
common_failures: dividing by a possibly zero expression

subject: geometry
title: State geometric nondegeneracy assumptions
statement: Record incidence, angle, and nondegeneracy assumptions before applying a geometric theorem.
common_failures: using a theorem in a degenerate case

subject: number-theory
title: Track integrality and coprimality
statement: Declare integrality and coprimality before divisibility or modular arguments and test boundary residues.
common_failures: cancelling a nonunit modulo a composite modulus

subject: combinatorics
title: Verify counting partitions
statement: Define the counted objects and verify that case splits are disjoint and exhaustive.

subject: probability
title: Check probability normalization
statement: Specify the sample space and verify nonnegativity and total probability one before using a distribution.

subject: calculus
title: Justify analytic interchanges
statement: Verify the relevant hypotheses before interchanging a limit, derivative, integral, or infinite sum.
common_failures: treating an interchange as a formal algebraic step

subject: linear-algebra
title: Check linear algebra dimensions
statement: Check dimensions before matrix products and state rank, basis, and invertibility assumptions explicitly.
common_failures: assuming a square matrix is invertible

subject: differential-equations
title: Verify differential equation solutions
statement: Substitute a proposed solution into the equation and apply every initial or boundary condition.
